question: Can anonymous bit-change fragments learned separately in push-only and collect-only worlds compose an exact transition model when both mechanisms first coexist?
controls: full-context memory receives identical experience and must know zero never-trained joint contexts
condition-deleted bit functions receive identical experience and must trail the fragment chain by at least 25 percentage points on joint contexts
both separate training families must retain exact one-step prediction
the first holdout is executed twice and must be bit-identical
all model write counters must remain unchanged during evaluation

classifier_dev.role: development candidate routing only; absent from training, evaluation, and runtime

failure_policy: Retain every miss; do not replace seeds, alter code, or lower gates after holdout execution.
boundary: Developer-frozen synthetic one-step world-function test. Raw bit channels, action-relative window, action interface, task generators, and evaluator are supplied.
